item.description: Shopify's decision to shift away from React Native highlights the fundamental limits of cross-platform abstractions at enterprise scale. We break down the technical trade-offs between unified JavaScript runtimes, native thread execution, and platform-specific engineering.

item.title: Deconstructing Model Distillation Attacks: How Frontier LLMs Are Systematically Harvested via Inference APIs
item.description: Anthropic's latest disclosures detail persistent distillation campaigns by rival labs targeting frontier model architectures. Here is a technical breakdown of how student models siphon reasoning traces from teacher APIs, how frontier providers detect behavioral extraction, and what this means for ML infrastructure security.

item.title: The Architectural Limits of Cross-Platform Frameworks: Why Shopify is Transitioning Back to Native Development
item.description: Shopify's decision to move away from React Native back to platform-native iOS and Android development signals a major shift in enterprise mobile strategy. This deep dive explores the technical performance bottlenecks, memory overhead, and maintenance costs that emerge when cross-platform abstractions meet massive organizational scale.
